biotools.summary: eccDNA2Ca is an interpretable ensemble learning framework designed to predict cancer-associated extrachromosomal circular DNA (eccDNA) directly from raw genomic sequences. It utilizes deep learning (CNN/LSTM) integrated with XGBoost to prioritize functional cancer biomarkers.
